home_page.title: Welcome to our workshop!
home_page.subtitle: We specialize in hand-customizing clothing, turning ordinary items into unique works of art.
home_page.text: Here, every item gets a second life and becomes a reflection of your individuality. Explore our catalog to find inspiration or contact us to create something completely new.

about_page.title: About Us
about_page.p1: We are a small but passionate team of artists and designers united by a love for style, art, and self-expression. Our mission is to give clothes a second life, transforming them from everyday wardrobe items into unique art pieces.
about_page.p2: Every embroidery, drawing, или rhinestone inlay is done by hand with special attention to detail. We believe that clothing should tell a story and reflect the inner world of its owner.
about_page.p3: Join our movement for conscious and creative fashion!
